name: cta
title: Call to action
description: The closing call to action that ends every site page.
usage: The last section before the footer, on every page. `ClosingCta` with a `pill-outline` button and a `CtaTextLink`. `Cta` and `CtaButton` (the water band) are deprecated; the site no longer draws it.
avoid: Two call to action sections on one page
The deprecated water band (Cta) on new pages

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
